messages:
Aisha: Quick heads up — HelixAI renewal (Acct: HEL-12) next Wed. PM says 2 onboarding modules incomplete; procurement hasn't returned vendor code. Risk: customer may ask for 60-day ramp instead of 30. Need decision: postpone signature or add training credit?
Tom: Noted. Who's owning vendor code chase?
Priya: I pinged their procurement yesterday. They asked for our updated SOW + KMS appendix.
Aisha: @liam-sales can you share SOW link? Also we might need 'training credit' addendum template.
Liam: Here: https://redwood.internal/sow/HEL-12-v3 — doc has new SLAs, missing KMS section. I'll add vendor code placeholder.
Priya: Procurement asked for PO timeline — they prefer net30 and invoice to subsidiary. That impacts billing entity.
Tom: If billing entity changes, legal needs to approve the esign flow. @sylvia-legal?
Sylvia: Quick check — esign via DocuSign OK if we have delegated signer docs. If billing entity != contract entity we need a short addendum. Can we route to admin@helix for delegated sig?
Aisha: We also have onboarding sessions scheduled on Mon/Wed. If they push term we should still deliver sessions but mark as 'at-risk'.
Tom: Propose: 1) Send SOW+KMS section today; 2) Offer training credit (1 extra week) as concession; 3) Keep esign open but add fallback: wet-sign or PO acceptance + invoice. Thoughts?
Priya: +1. Procurement prefers PO > wet-sign. If PO arrives we can auto-provision once PO accepted.
Liam: I'll draft addendum and training credit clause. ETA EOD.
Sylvia: I'll pre-approve addendum template. If they insist on PO-only, add sign-off step in onboarding checklist.
Docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: env_98231 — waiting for signer. https://docusign.com/env/98231
Tom: Great. @aisha-cs label this thread with 'renewal-risk' and 'onboarding-at-risk' and I'll follow up with CSM digest.
Aisha: Done. Thanks team. I'll chase procurement and update this thread with PO or esign status. :thumbsup:
Liam: FYI, pricing change? They asked about shifting from 12-month to 9-month billing — sales wants to keep ARR. Holding pattern.
Priya: Capture that as negotiation point. If they shorten term, include prorate table and seat true-up in addendum.
Aisha: Added to checklist. Will escalate if we don't have vendor code by EOD tomorrow.
Tom: Pinged procurement contact again. If no response by 10am PST we'll route to account exec.
Aisha: Last: please confirm who will field post-sign onboarding -> Tom or Priya?
Tom: I'll own kickoff once contract signed. Priya stays for technical runbook.
Aisha: Perfect. Closing for now — update here with any docs/PO/DS envelope numbers.
